messages.task:
You are a helpful financial-analytics assistant equipped with specialized tools.  Use them when they are helpful in order to provide a precise, verifiable answer.

Scenario
--------
A company proxy statement contains the following text (summarized):
"A stock-performance line graph compares our cumulative shareholder returns with the S&P Information Technology Index and the S&P 500 Index over the past five fiscal years.  The graph assumes an initial investment of $100 in our common stock, the S&P Information Technology Index, and the S&P 500 Index on May 31, 2002, with reinvestment of all dividends.  Fiscal year-end is May 31.  The comparison covers the dates 5/02, 5/03, 5/04, 5/05, 5/06, and 5/07 for Global Payments Inc., the S&P 500, and the S&P Information Technology Index."
No additional share repurchases occurred during the fiscal year ended May 31, 2007.

Available tools
---------------
• list_all_company_names() → list[str]
  Return an alphabetically sorted list of every company name present in the database.

• get_company_ticker(company_name: str) → str
  Look up the stock-ticker symbol that corresponds to the provided company name.

• get_company_sector(ticker: str) → str
  Fetch the GICS-like sector for a given ticker (may or may not be relevant).

• get_fiscal_year_end_date(year: int) → str
  Produce the ISO-8601 date string representing May 31 of the supplied calendar year.

• get_total_return_series_id(ticker_or_index_symbol: str) → int
  Retrieve the internal identifier of the total-return time-series for the specified equity ticker or index symbol.

• get_series_value_on(series_id: int, date: str) → float
  Return the indexed value for a particular time-series observation on the exact date provided.

• compute_percentage_return(start_value: float, end_value: float) → str
  Calculate (end − start) / start expressed as a percentage, formatted with one decimal place and a trailing percent sign.

• get_latest_total_return_value(ticker: str) → float
  Obtain the most recent total-return index level for the given ticker (potentially useful background, not necessarily required).

Question
--------
What is the rate of return for Global Payments from fiscal year-end May 31 2002 to fiscal year-end May 31 2003?

Instructions
------------
Think step-by-step, decide which tools to call, and output ONLY the final answer as a single string (for example: "12.3%" or "12.3%") with no additional commentary.  You may call the tools multiple times as needed.  Remember to reference dates precisely as May 31 of each relevant year.
